messages:
docs-ryan: Heads up: the API ref streaming example for POST /v1/generate/stream shows SSE events with `data: [DONE]` and uses a field named `chunk` in JSON. Live servers send `data: [DONE]` as its own event line and JSON deltas use `delta` not `chunk`. Also example misses Content-Type: text/event-stream header.
eng-mira: ugh, thanks. That example came from an early prototype. Runtime settled on `delta` to match chat streaming. We should fix the snippet and explicitly show the correct SSE framing.
docs-ryan: minimal curl to reproduce:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream -d '{"model_id":"g-1","input":"hi"}'
```
observed stream sample:
```
event: message
id: 1
data: {"delta":"Hello","role":"assistant"}

event: message
id: 2
data: {"delta":" world","role":"assistant"}

event: done
id: 3
data: [DONE]

```
sdk-noah: our JS example still listens for `chunk` and parses line-by-line assuming no event field. I'll update SDK snippets after docs PR. We should also add a note: clients must parse SSE events and expect `data: [DONE]` as the final event value.
pm-evie: can we add a tiny migration note for customers using the older non-SSE long-polling client? Some have telemetry showing failed parsers.
docs-ryan: will open PR to replace the example, add the correct SSE framing, include both a short SSE consumer snippet and a fallback long-poll example with a migration note. PR #6128 coming up.
bot-lint: docs lint: example code fence language missing (warning).
eng-mira: will review PR quickly. also file an infra task to scan other streaming endpoints for `chunk` vs `delta` mismatches.
sdk-noah: thumbs up; i'll coordinate a quick SDK patch after merge.
